prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
New interactive flows (new_flow) delivered the largest wins (up to +14.8%), but predictions were often overly optimistic as several variants caused severe drops (down to -11.8%).
Step reordering (reorder) drove major wins (up to +12.0%), though it carried high risk, frequently producing no clear effect or severe drops (down to -8.9%).
Wait-state information (wait_info) generated multiple solid wins (up to +6.1%), occasionally exceeding conservative predictions (+6.1% vs +3.2%), though several variants showed no clear effect.
Targeted copy updates (copy) yielded selective wins (up to +6.7%), though the majority of copy tests resulted in no clear effect.
UI redesigns (redesign) frequently caused severe drops (down to -19.3%), but a companion selection layout redesign produced a major win (+8.5%), vastly outperforming pessimistic predictions (-5.0%).
Hints (hint), notifications (notification), layout changes (layout), and standalone preview screens (new_screen) failed to produce any wins, with hints sometimes worsening performance (down to -3.1%).

Changes:
0: [finish, new_flow] Interactive Desktop Pet Shortcut Sandbox Flow: Adds an interactive desktop shortcut sandbox on the home intro screen where users practice summoning and toggling pet visibility. (why: Support emails show 3 users reported pets not displaying or app not opening, while 3 emails reported confusion on how to control or hide the pet. Finish step drops to 73.5%.)
1: [home, wait_info] Desktop Graphics Status & Preparation Timer: Displays desktop graphics readiness checks and a countdown status indicator on the waiting screen. (why: Home waiting screen has a median duration of 201s and mean of 2336s, causing drop-offs before completion. Support emails reported 3 instances of pet desktop display failures.)
2: [sign_in, copy] Multi-Device Account Retrieval Sign-In Copy: Clarifies that signing in restores existing pets across devices and prevents accidental pet resets. (why: 8 support emails (the top support theme) reported pets missing or reset after signing in again.)
3: [adoption, new_flow] Interactive Pet Trait Confirmation Sandbox Flow: Adds an interactive trait confirmation sandbox on the adoption certificate screen where users test pet behaviors before finishing adoption. (why: Adoption step takes 1017s mean time with 83.5% conversion, and users express confusion after onboarding about pet control.)
4: [adoption, redesign] Card Grid Redesign for Companion Friend Picker: Redesign companion selection stage into a structured card grid highlighting pet attributes and desktop compatibility. (why: Adoption step conversion is 83.5% with high mean duration (1017s). Stage layout redesign previously yielded +8.5% conversion.)
5: [home, wait_info] Waiting Screen Render Queue Progress Breakdown: Shows structured render queue milestones and live preparation tips on the waiting screen. (why: Home step duration is high (mean 2336s, median 201s). Wait-state info updates previously produced wins up to +6.1%.)
6: [choose_path, copy] Path Expectation & Setup Time Clarity Copy: Updates choose path headline and hint to clarify initial setup duration and outcome expectations. (why: Choose path is the lowest first-run step conversion (78.3%), with a high mean time of 514s.)
7: [finish, new_flow] Interactive Pet Docking Practice Flow: Adds an interactive pet docking practice mini-flow on home intro letting users practice dragging and docking the companion. (why: Finish step conversion drops to 73.5% (mean 5815s) and 3 support emails reported confusion controlling the desktop pet.)
